notes.cold: fresh context, CDP cache disabled, server `cache-control: no-store`
notes.warm: same context loads the page once unmeasured, then again with immutable caching
notes.bytes: `wireBytes` = sum of CDP encodedDataLength (headers + gzip body);  `bodyBytes` = gzip bodies as served
notes.time: ms from navigation start;  `firstPaint`/`allPainted` = two frames after the first/last icon was ready
notes.net: local = loopback;  net = 40 ms RTT, 20 Mbit/s down, 10 Mbit/s up (CDP emulation)

svgAsShipped.note: includes FA alias copies (e.g. ad.svg, add.svg)

today.note: every data chunk is emitted (CHUNK_LOADERS lists them all):  cannot include just the icons named

module.note: static imports tree-shake to exactly the named paths, inlined into the app bundle

svgUrlDefault.note: files under 4 KB become data: URIs by Vite's default `assetsInlineLimit`

svgUrlNoInline.note: one hashed file per named icon, nothing else

bundling.computedNames: a URL built from a runtime name (all of candidates 2, 3a, 3b as `ui-icon name=...` would use them) is invisible to a bundler:  the app must copy the whole set, or import the named icons statically and register them
